newsitem.title: UK: Bass, brewers up on capacity cut hopes.
newsitem.headline: Bass, brewers up on capacity cut hopes.

text.p: Shares in Bass Plc and other UK brewers rose on Thursday after a report that Carlsberg-Tetley planned to close at least one of its UK breweries, easing overcapacity in the industry, dealers said.
Bass shares were up 15p at 854p by 1113 GMT, Scottish & Newcastle Plc was up 4-1/2p at 734-1/2p and Whitbread Plc was up 6p at 843-1/2p.
A major investment fund was also said to have an order for Bass shares in the market today.
A report in the Financial Times said Carlsberg-Tetley planned to end brewing at Alloa in Scotland and possibly Wrexham in Wales, after the UK government blocked its planned merger with Bass.
